# Ontology Manifest/v1

The stable identity and configuration record for one Ontology, distinct from its subjects, histories, cuts, views, packages, and runtime process.

## Claim ceiling

This is a candidate ontology-manifest/v1 carrier bound to one admitted Definition. PASS proves only its exact closed schema, fixtures, and projections; it does not admit the type or instance, create a relation, migrate an ontology, or activate a runtime.
